chart.name: Server overview
chart.programText:
A = histogram('kong_ai_mcp_latency_ms').mean(by=['service.instance.id', 'service.name']).mean(by=['service.instance.id', 'service.name']).publish(label='A')
C = histogram('kong_ai_mcp_latency_ms').count(by=['service.instance.id', 'service.name']).sum(by=['service.instance.id', 'service.name']).publish(label='C')
B = data('kong_ai_mcp_error_total', rollup='delta').sum(by=['service.instance.id', 'service.name']).publish(label='B')
H = (B/C).scale(100).publish(label='H')
D = histogram('kong_ai_mcp_latency_ms').sum(by=['service', 'service.instance.id', 'service.name']).count(by=['service', 'service.name', 'service.instance.id']).sum(by=['service.name', 'service.instance.id']).publish(label='D')
E = histogram('kong_ai_mcp_latency_ms').sum(by=['service.instance.id', 'service.name', 'route']).count(by=['service.name', 'service.instance.id', 'route']).sum(by=['service.name', 'service.instance.id']).publish(label='E')
F = histogram('kong_ai_mcp_latency_ms').sum(by=['service.instance.id', 'service.name', 'workspace']).count(by=['service.name', 'service.instance.id', 'workspace']).sum(by=['service.name', 'service.instance.id']).publish(label='F')
